fieldNotes.truckGate: Channelized lane group with painted islands and a queue of tractor-trailers funneling through a single checkpoint mid-campus at ~34.1531,-117.4244; classic controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Gatehouse building with a canopy extending over the inbound truck lanes (z20/z21), windows on multiple sides, set beside the lanes — a staffed guard booth, not the main warehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two ~1.5M-sqft warehouses (west + east) on one fenced 3.1M-sqft / 240-acre campus.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Massive central drop yard between the two buildings holding many hundreds of parked trailers in herringbone rows.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks face the central yard (west building east wall, east building west wall) plus perimeter dock faces — physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach road runs north from the public road into the campus before reaching the gate, with deep stacking room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~160 ac for the fenced operational rectangle measured from the perimeter ring; full campus parcel is ~240 ac including southern graded land.
fieldNotes.streetView: Only public pano is a 2007 capture on the south access road predating the built facility and not showing the gate; no interior coverage. hasCoverage set false rather than invent a pano.
